option_relations.rationale: Fibrolipoma does not match the histological findings and clinical presentation
Hamartoma is a broad term and does not specifically match the histological findings and clinical presentation
The histological findings of mature adipose and fibrous tissues and the clinical presentation match the characteristics of fibrofatty residua of involuted infantile hemangioma
Lipoma does not match the histological findings and clinical presentation, which include fibrous tissues and a history of involution
